agent_report.reasoning: Source-only inspection of unchanged panel.png identified a linear Pressure (mbar) axis with printed ticks 0–1200 and a linear Gas uptake (mmol/g) axis with printed ticks 0–5. The native legend maps eleven filled, solid CO2 series (273K–373K) and separately lists six N2 series; all N2 ink was excluded. There is no inset and spec.json supplies no masks. Independent tick-stroke fits used x pixels 126,270,414,558,703,845,989 for 0,200,...,1200 mbar and y pixels 708,584,459,336,212,86 for 0,1,...,5 mmol/g. After calibration, the full Agent 03 CSV/JSON and all 102 review_tiles.json items were checked against native pixels, including crowded_strip:01 and crowded_strip:02. Twelve rows were deleted: six template-derived rows lacked a same-series native marker core, and six CO2 293K rows at x=123.13 or x=184–255px contradicted the triangle-up 293K trajectory (the latter sat on the lower dark-blue family or outside the nonnegative start). Crowded/fused candidate coordinates were conservatively reclassified as line_sample rather than claimed as discrete markers. Native-supported line samples were added only on observed same-series ink to fill continuous-band gaps; no trace extends beyond visible ink. Each eligible series receives a low-confidence estimated_marker at the shared zero-axis intersection because its colored trajectory reaches the fused origin and the column is shared, but ownership is not individually visible. The saved CSV was reloaded and plotted over panel.png; all eleven reconstructed bands align with their native curves, no N2 baseline series is included, and the largest along-band x gap is 18.00 native pixels. Verdict is review because line_sample and estimated_marker rows remain and low-pressure discrete marker counts are unresolved.
